description: This file defines functions and types related to execution approval policies, including scope snapshots, resolution logic, and configuration handling for the openclaw project.

methods.name: formatRequestedSource
methods.description: Formats the source string for requested security or ask based on source path and default value.

methods.name: resolveRequestedField
methods.description: Resolves the value and source path for a requested field (security or ask) from scope, global config, or default.

methods.name: formatHostFieldSource
methods.description: Formats the source string for host policy fields, including defaults.

methods.name: resolveAskNote
methods.description: Generates a note explaining the relationship between requested, host, and effective ask values.

methods.name: collectExecPolicyScopeSnapshots
methods.description: Collects snapshots of execution policy scopes for tools and agents based on configuration and approvals.

methods.name: resolveExecPolicyScopeSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of an execution policy scope, omitting allowed decisions.

methods.name: resolveExecPolicyScopeSnapshot
methods.description: Resolves a detailed snapshot of execution policy for a given scope, including security, ask, and decisions.
